profile.headline: Senior Front End Developer @ Chamberlain Group
profile.summary: Front End Developer with 9+ years of experience in Angular, RxJs, NgRx, Vue, and Vuex. Proven track record of success in developing and delivering high-quality web applications. Lead a team of developers and managed sprint planning. Expertise in all phases of the software development lifecycle, from requirements gathering and analysis to design, implementation, testing, and deployment. Strong problem-solving and analytical skills. Ability to work independently and as part of a team.

positions.title: Senior Software Developer
positions.description:
I work as a Team Lead Front-end Developer, responsible for managing multiple applications using Angular and Vue.js. These applications have Java-based backends, with APIs received from AWS, and our API services are hosted on EC2.

My primary role involves creating applications for insurance members, enabling them to manage prescriptions, member information, side effects, allergies, and generate reports. I engage with the business to understand their requirements and then translate them into user stories, distributing tasks to the team while ensuring adherence to timelines.

Coordinating with the backend team is another key responsibility. I work on request/response changes as per requirements, debug Java code, and perform API testing using Postman. Additionally, I handle change requests on ServiceNow for production modifications.

I've developed micro frontends for multiple Angular applications using module federation. To enhance the application's performance and user experience, I've implemented global interceptors for preprocessing and post-processing of requests and responses. I've also created reusable services for API calls with error handling using RxJS in Angular.

Further optimizations include implementing lazy loading in the router for faster load times and superior application performance. I've introduced reactive forms to manage complex forms and provide more flexibility for error handling. Unit testing has been implemented using Karma and Jasmine.

In addition to my Angular work, I've built applications from scratch using Vue, Vuex, and Vuetify. I've leveraged the Axios HTTP client library to establish interceptors and make API calls. State management is handled through a Vuex store, and I've developed reusable components, mixins, and services. I've integrated a router for smooth navigation between components and upgraded the Vue framework from version 2 to 3, incorporating the Composition API.
positions.insights: Skills: RxJS · Angular · Axios · Vuex · Vue.js

positions.title: Senior Frontend Developer
positions.description:
I developed an application called Empath using Vue and Vuex, and I utilized AWS for API integration and data transfer, employing JSON for communication with the API.
I was responsible for ensuring the responsive style, look, and feel of the web page. I used SASS, which extends CSS with dynamic behavior, including variables, mixins, operations, and functions.
I designed and developed reusable user interface components in Vue, incorporating JavaScript and ES6 features. I deployed the code using Jenkins.
In addition, I worked on data analysis, utilizing Splunk dashboards and responding to PagerDuty alerts.
I have experience with agile methodology and use Jira as a storyboard, and GitHub for version control.
I developed unit tests using Jest and conducted end-to-end testing using Cypress.
Furthermore, I conducted code reviews for each pull request and actively participated in team-building exercises, always providing support to help the team meet deadlines.

positions.title: Solutions Specialist
positions.description:
I have developed several applications using different JavaScript frameworks, including Angular and Vue.
My responsibilities included creating efficient designs and developing user interaction screens using HTML, SCSS, Bootstrap, JavaScript, Angular 8, and Node.js. I also designed and implemented custom, self-contained, reusable, and testable components, directives, and services to drive key functionalities within the system.
Furthermore, I have experience in developing applications using Vue, Vuex, TypeScript, SCSS, and Node.js. In this context, I created custom components, services, and routers with core logic.
I have extensive experience in integrating RESTful services (APIs) and have utilized JSON for data transfer between the frontend and backend. Additionally, I used SQL queries to interact with the Oracle database.
I also had the responsibility of ensuring the style, look, and feel of the web pages, making use of SASS to extend CSS with dynamic features like variables, mixins, operations, and functions.
positions.insights: Skills: RxJS · Angular · NgRx · Vuex · Vue.js

positions.title: Frontend Developer
positions.description:
Responsible for developing the UI pages using Angular 2/4, HTML5, CSS3, JavaScript, PrimeNG, and Bootstrap.


In charge of the style, appearance, and overall feel of the web pages, utilizing SASS to extend CSS with dynamic features such as variables, mixins, operations, and functions.
Employed various custom directives in Angular 2 and designed reusable components and templates that could be reused throughout the application.
Worked with Angular 2 to create single-page applications and utilized NgRx for managing Angular applications.
Created reusable components and services in TypeScript for consuming REST APIs, following a component-based architecture provided by Angular 2.
Implemented HTTP requests using the RxJS Observable library to handle multiple values over time.
Experienced in working with advanced JavaScript, including ECMAScript 6 (ES6).
Recently migrated an application from Angular 4.0 to Angular 5.0.
Utilized JASMINE for testing and Protractor for unit testing of Angular modules.
Adept in creating and bundling complex applications using Webpack or packaging them with gulp/grunt.
Worked within the Kanban methodology to provide more efficient work processes and higher quality.
Utilized JIRA for bug tracking, with Git as the version control tool, and Jenkins for continuous integration of builds.

positions.title: Frontend Developer
positions.description:
Designed dynamic and multi-browser compatible pages using HTML, CSS, jQuery, JavaScript, and AngularJS.
Utilized AngularJS components such as modules, controllers, and built-in models, synchronizing them with single-page applications (SPAs).
Utilized the CSS preprocessor SASS to enhance the efficiency of CSS, and employed Bourbon, a lightweight Sass toolset that enhances the effectiveness of style sheets.
Had experience in integrating RESTful services (APIs) and used JSON for data transfer between the frontend and backend. Additionally, employed SQL queries to interact with the Oracle database.
Worked on cross-browser compatibility and resolved bugs for various browsers.
Utilized Firebug to debug JavaScript, analyze DOM objects on the page, and make adjustments to the page layout.
Collaborated with JIRA, a project management tool for managing project requirements and tasks, while using GitHub as the version control system.
Followed Agile methodologies, specifically Scrum, to manage the full life-cycle development of the project.

positions.title: Frontend Developer
positions.description:
Contributed to the development of the user interface using HTML/HTML5, CSS/CSS3, JavaScript, jQuery, AJAX, and JSON.
Participated in writing application-level code to interact with APIs and web services using AJAX, JSON, and XML.
Created reusable templates and stylesheets based on UI standards and guidelines.
Performed functional tasks based on specifications and wireframes.
Made extensive use of debugging JavaScript using the Chrome Developer Toolbar and Firebug.
Coordinated with Interface Design Architects to ensure code-level compliance with accessibility standards.
Participated in an agile development cycle as a part of the team, following the Scrum methodology.
